plan_ref: implementation and test_edge_plan.md TE-04 (lines 679-706); guides G3 RF-04, G2 sections 10-11
gate: P1 opens only after P0 (TE-03.7 structural controls) PASSES
clauses: pilot subset follows the registered rule with enough warmup, coverage and parameter opportunity
pilot arms share the same dates and economics
per-cell paired accounts are produced with all planned statuses and source/design identity
M4_CAL, M4_REGIME and the budget-aware control run under the registered hypotheses
placebo/delay/risk controls are added per hypotheses, with control fidelity recorded
actual compute, exposure and refit counts are measured; no control is dropped for winning
full Mode 4 transparency at every cutoff: temporal components, cluster/plateau/fallback
only unique behavioral candidates are counted, with admissibility denominators
daily return, Sharpe, PF and drawdown are normalized; positions, costs and terminal effects recorded
raw and canonical metrics are reported side by side, never silently substituted
first-return, partition and missing-date behavior is tested, not assumed
D1/D2/D3 are measured and the decay comparison between methods follows the registered design
per-fold tables are complete: contrast, effect, CI and support — not row counts
paired inference is dependence-aware with multiplicity control
estimand, weights, active-cell count, date mask, bootstrap draws/seed, delta and corrected significance are all recorded
model metrics are joined to every fold and account; the attribution funnel names information vs opportunity vs activation vs costs with evidence for each claim
scaling proceeds by shards only when technical, support and budget gates pass
all 20 cells get a status row; losers and failures are kept, never filtered
a performance profile and resume manifest are produced per shard batch
one design is frozen (design_freeze.json) or a no-promising/insufficient-design decision is recorded with an exposed-data ledger
the next action is planned with explicit limits
TEF-01
statistical windows exclude the warmup period before the evaluation window
TEF-02
D2 age windows do not share boundary days
TEF-03
profit factor is computed from a closed-trade ledger with correct states; daily PF is reported separately
TEF-04
the decay table answers the method comparison inside the tested scope
TEF-09
the positive control exercises the full learned pipeline, not a stub
TEF-17
statistics and claim gates are calibrated before any claim is made
TEF-18
attribution controls exist and the study design is complete, not partial
TEF-19
execution lineage is preserved and metric aliases are never conflated
TE04-COV-1
route status for every cell is read from the route registry at run time, never hardcoded
TE04-COV-2
cells without initial history (R01: SOL/DOGE legs) and cells without a qualified route stay blocked with null metrics plus reason, unless a new registration resolves coverage
TE04-COV-3
no cell is silently dropped and no missing metric is filled with zero
TE04-EXIT-1
the phase ends with a scoped conclusion; a negative or inconclusive result is valid and is published, not rerun until it wins
TE04-EXIT-2
no peeking: statistical looks and any stopping rule are registered before results; a technical or budget stop is reported as a stop, never as a negative effect
